== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-tantiveiv-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Tantive IV (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same game text. The game text is set again and the white “E” in the lower border is gone; a small round bronze disc sits in the lower right corner of the card. The type line is back to the printed “CAPITAL: CORVETTE” and the stat box to “ARMOR 4”.

The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
